new_today_news.headline: City Breaks Ground on Wastewater Treatment Plant Expansion
new_today_news.summary: Eagle Mountain City broke ground on a wastewater treatment plant expansion to handle growing demand from the city's rapidly increasing population. The project will upgrade the existing plant and build a new membrane bioreactor facility adding 6 MGD capacity, with construction expected to take three to four years.

new_today_news.headline: New fuel, same planes: Inside the bid to clean up air travel with cooking oil and captured carbon
new_today_news.summary: Montana Renewables aims to expand SAF production from 60 million gallons annually to 200 million by end of 2028, addressing the U.S. government's goal of 3 billion gallons of SAF annually by 2030. SAF production faces cost challenges but is expected to become cheaper as production scales.

new_today_news.headline: Morocco's $239M Plan: Turning Used Cooking Oil into Jet Fuel
new_today_news.summary: Morocco is developing a $239 million SAF facility using Axens' Vegan HEFA technology to process waste-based oils and fats, with expected startup in August 2028. The plant will also produce renewable diesel, renewable naphtha, and bio-propane.

new_today_news.headline: Brunswick Wastewater Expansion to Cost Hundreds of Millions as Development Outpaces Capacity
new_today_news.summary: Brunswick County wastewater plants are exceeding capacity with new sewer permits frozen under state law. Commissioners are considering $250 million to $1 billion in infrastructure investments, with one plant expansion set to break ground in August 2027 to increase capacity from 1.5 MGD to 9.5-15.5 MGD.

recent_news.headline: Dump Truck Insurance Costs in 2026: Rates & Factors
recent_news.summary: Dump truck insurance for a single unit typically runs $9,000-$20,000 annually for standard operators, with higher rates for new authorities and high-risk materials. Monthly premiums for established owner-operators fall in the $750-$1,700 range.
